name: Proteus Space

overview.value: Los Angeles-headquartered Proteus Space started in 2021. Its flagship product, Mercury, autonomously designs custom satellite buses tailored to specific payloads, minimizing errors and rework in satellite design. Proteus describes its core focus areas as also including additive manufacturing, payload integration, digital twins, and de-orbit planning.

focus.value: Designs and manufactures custom satellite buses using its AI-enabled Mercury platform
